retained_attempts.cause: Discovery assertion updated from 52 to 72; original visual and numeric tolerances retained.

limitations: One laptop, sequential warm-up30s/measurement60s per variant/GPU; no repeated randomized or thermal-soak causal speedup qualification.
Application present-return cadence is not display scanout FPS or click-to-photon latency.
CPU stages overlap; AO/filter/deferred intervals are nested in post/total. No overlapping durations are summed.
Capture timings cover two frames and small fixtures; continuous measurements use independent native frame rows.
Performance Yard visual captures cover the authored static scene, not its running Native AOT gameplay state.
Tiny-projection fallback is not guaranteed to be exercised by these fixtures; its dedicated GPU coverage remains unqualified.
Imported Idle spectators/shared boxes are not production-art complexity, crowd AI or GPU instancing qualification.
Skinning includes shadow-only geometry. Authored rig counts do not prove all rigs are camera-visible.
Dynamic boxes can settle. Native navigation workload belongs to one moving player.
Memory samples cover process working set/private commit separately; GPU residency and audibility are unqualified.
Existing caches, fresh native process/scene upload; clean-cache and edit-to-play performance unqualified.
Image and probe equivalence cover the stated fixtures, not general physical AO correctness.
Only staged phonon.dll is pinned alongside the CLI; system/driver libraries are outside that file closure.
